topic: Investigating historical session data drop for AFA
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on a reported ~30% drop in session data for AFA during the period of September 1 to September 27, 2023. The initial analysis found that recalculating raw seen data did not resolve the issue, and the drop was observed only for AFA.

It was noted that checking other companies' data would have revealed any systemic issues with the raw data pipeline or date/time handling. Since this was isolated to AFA, the cause is likely related to a specific change or event affecting only that company.
